### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. spermatogenic failure 19  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.715)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:26684)

**Proposed mechanism:** CFAP43 (HGNC:26684) —DISRUPTS→ Ciliary function and assembly (GO:0005928); Ciliary function and assembly (GO:0005928) —LEADS_TO→ Normal pressure hydrocephalus (MONDO:0009366); CFAP43 (HGNC:26684) —DISRUPTS→ Spermiogenesis (GO:0007287); Spermiogenesis (GO:0007287) —LEADS_TO→ Spermatogenic failure 19 (MONDO:0054723).
